profile.name: 函数/任意波形发生器
profile.description: 这是一台台式函数/任意波形发生器，用于输出可控的正弦波等测试信号，并可进行触发与突发输出设置。它常用于电子电路调试、仪器联调、激励信号注入和实验室通用信号源应用。
profile.description_en: This is a benchtop function/arbitrary waveform generator used to produce controlled test signals such as sine waves, with support for triggering and burst-style output. It is commonly used for electronic circuit testing, instrument synchronization, stimulus injection, and general laboratory signal-source tasks.

registry.name: Agilent Technologies Agilent33210A
registry.description: Agilent33210 A是由Agilent Technologies生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括触发、运行。支持Signal, Slot, beep等操作。
